description: This PHP class 'PublisherDelete' is responsible for managing deletion of pages in a Confluence publishing context. It handles listing deletable pages and performing deletion if configured.

classes.name: PublisherDelete
classes.description: A class for deleting pages from Confluence, listing pages that can be deleted, and executing deletions based on configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with output interface, delete flag, and API client.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Determines whether to list or delete pages based on internal state and input.

methods.name: listDeletable
methods.description: Recursively traverses the published pages to identify deletable pages.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Executes deletion of identified pages through the API client.

methods.name: displayDeletable
methods.description: Displays the list of pages that could be deleted without actually deleting them.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets output, delete flag, and API client.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the process by listing or deleting pages based on the delete flag.

methods.name: listDeletable
methods.description: Recursively collects pages that can be deleted.

methods.name: displayDeletable
methods.description: Displays pages marked for deletion without deleting.
